name: wxo-builder
description: Build, deploy, and manage IBM Watsonx Orchestrate AI agents, tools, and flows in VS Code. Create OpenAPI/Python tools, test locally & remotely, export as MCP server for Cursor/Claude, import Langflow flows.

commands.title: Fix All Python Tools for CLI

wxo-builder.apiKey.markdownDescription: The default API key for Watson Orchestrate in this workspace. Corresponds to `WO_API_KEY`. Use the WxO Builder Systems panel/tab when you want to manage multiple named systems or switch environments without editing settings directly.

wxo-builder.trialApiKey.markdownDescription: Default long service credential (`username:password`) for trial instances in this workspace. Corresponds to `WO_TRIAL_API_KEY`. Used if standard apiKey is missing or fails. Use the WxO Builder Systems panel/tab for saved trial systems and environment switching.

wxo-builder.mcspTokenUrl.markdownDescription: MCSP IAM token endpoint for trial instances (e.g. `api.dl.watson-orchestrate.ibm.com`). Only change this if your trial instance uses a different IAM region. Corresponds to `WO_MCSP_TOKEN_URL`.

wxo-builder.instanceUrl.markdownDescription: The default Watson Orchestrate instance URL for this workspace. Corresponds to `WO_INSTANCE_URL`. Use the WxO Builder Systems panel/tab to maintain multiple instance definitions and choose between them from the extension UI.

wxo-builder.debug.markdownDescription: Enable debug logging to the Extension Host console. Filter by `[WxO Editor]` or `[WxO]`.

wxo-builder.agentId.markdownDescription: Optional agent ID for remote tool runs. The default Orchestrate Assistant may not have your tool — it can hallucinate instead of executing. Create an agent in WxO with this tool attached and set its ID here for real tool execution.

wxo-builder.scope.markdownDescription: Environment scope: draft (development) or live (production). Tools and connections are created/edited in this scope.

wxo-builder.toolsShowInAdk.markdownDescription: When true (default), newly created tools use ADK-compatible schema (connections: {}, output_schema) so they appear in `orchestrate tools list -v`. Set to false if you prefer tools that may not show in the CLI.

wxo-builder.syncInstances.markdownDescription: (Legacy) Instance configs used when `syncSources`/`syncTargets` are empty. Prefer using `syncSources` and `syncTargets`.

apiKey.description: IBM Cloud API key (optional; uses main apiKey if omitted)

wxo-builder.syncSources.markdownDescription:
Source instances for the Sync panel and Select System actions. If you prefer managing named environments from inside the extension, use the WxO Builder Systems panel/tab; these settings provide the same data as workspace configuration. Add to settings.json (use your instance URLs):

```json
"wxo-builder.syncSources": [
  { "alias": "Production", "instanceUrl": "https://api.us-south.watson-orchestrate.cloud.ibm.com/instances/xxx", "apiKey": "" },
  { "alias": "Test", "instanceUrl": "https://api.us-south.watson-orchestrate.cloud.ibm.com/instances/yyy" }
]
```

`apiKey` is optional when same as `wxo-builder.apiKey`.

wxo-builder.syncTargets.markdownDescription:
Target instances for the Sync panel. If you manage environments from the WxO Builder Systems panel/tab, keep those system definitions aligned with these target aliases. Add to settings.json (use your instance URLs):

```json
"wxo-builder.syncTargets": [
  { "alias": "ProductionCopy", "instanceUrl": "https://api.us-south.watson-orchestrate.cloud.ibm.com/instances/xxx", "apiKey": "" },
  { "alias": "TestCopy", "instanceUrl": "https://api.eu-de.watson-orchestrate.cloud.ibm.com/instances/yyy" }
]
```

`apiKey` is optional.

wxo-builder.defaultSyncSource.markdownDescription: Default Source alias for the Sync panel. Must match an alias in `syncSources` (or `syncInstances`), or leave empty for 'Current workspace'.

wxo-builder.defaultSyncTarget.markdownDescription: Default Target alias for the Sync panel. Must match an alias in `syncTargets` (or `syncInstances`), or leave empty for 'Current workspace'.

wxo-builder.exportRoot.markdownDescription: Root folder for WxO Exports and Imports. Default: `{workspaceRoot}/WxO`. When set, Agent/Sync export dialogs open in this folder. Use an absolute path or a path relative to the workspace (e.g. `./my-exports`). Tip: Open Settings (Ctrl+,) and search for 'exportRoot' to change.

scripts.pretest: npm run compile && npm run lint
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run compile
scripts.fix: npm run lint:fix && npm run format
scripts.test:import-langflow: npm run compile:tests && LANGFLOW_UNIQUE_NAME=1 node out/tests/scripts/import-langflow-flow.js
scripts.test:crud:all: npm run test:crud:agents && npm run test:crud:connections && npm run test:crud:tools && npm run test:crud:toolkits && npm run test:crud:knowledge-bases && npm run test:crud:evaluations && npm run test:crud:flows
scripts.test:ui:all: npm run test:ui:export-agent && npm run test:ui:export-tool && npm run test:ui:export-toolkit && npm run test:ui:export-knowledge-base && npm run test:ui:knowledge-base-editor && npm run test:ui:inspect-agent-run && npm run test:ui:recent-traces-agent && npm run test:ui:activate-deactivate-skill && npm run test:ui:import-toolkit
scripts.test:object-operations: npm run test:crud:all && npm run test:ui:all
